subject: SEND - New notification from ${notification.sender.paDenomination} - ${notification.iun}
body1: <#if recipientType=='PF'>You have<#else>Your business has</#if> received a notification on SEND - Servizio Notifiche Digitali.
body2: A notification is a legally binding communication consisting of a notification of receipt and one or more documents.
body3: <#if recipientType=='PF'>You have<#else>The business has up to 120 days from the date of finalization of the notification to access the documents. The deadline for payment, if applicable, and for any appeals is indicated in the documents.
read_more: You are receiving this notification of receipt as a <#if recipientType=='PF'>natural person<#else>legal entity with Fiscal Code ${recipient.taxId}. SEND is a tool that makes sending notifications by the Public Administration safer, more efficient and cheaper. Find out more
footer: The sending institution knows this PEC address because <#if recipientType=='PF'>you entered it in your<#else>the business entered it in its SEND contact details, because it is part of one of the registers provided for by the Digital Administration Code or because <#if recipientType=='PF'>you communicated it to them<#else>it was communicated to them in the past. To modify your contact details or add others, go to your contact details.
